title: Tim Burchett on the high rate of researchers disappearing

tellings.quote: He told the Daily Mail that the numbers seem very high in these certain areas of research.

plain: Congressman Tim Burchett has said that researchers in certain fields seem to be going missing at an unusually high rate. Michels reports that Burchett told the Daily Mail newspaper "the numbers seem very high in these certain areas of research." If he is right, scientists working in some sensitive fields are vanishing more often than chance would explain.
